messages:
alex: Heads-up — customer reported a case where a toolcall completed server-side but the streaming connection dropped before client ACK. They saw ~40 tokens billed as "final" then another ~40 provisional after reconnect. Not sure how our router/ledger stitched it.
maya: ugh, seen variations of this. Do we know which path the request took (primary -> fallback)?
devon: looks like primary handled the toolcall, forwarded to model, returned tool result, then stream socket closed during last chunk flush. Router retried to fallback path which replayed the prefix.
alex: so double-charge because the ledger treated the fallback replay as fresh tokens, provisional credits were later finalized?
billing-bot: note: provisional tokens are currently credited as provisional_id=pm_98765 and reconciled when session end event seen. If session end missing we hold provisional for N days then finalize.
sam: That N-days behavior is the root cause for this case — it's too coarse for fast streaming UX. Customer expects immediate consistent accounting.
maya: Options: 1) conservative wait-on-ack heuristic (delay finalize until toolcall ACK + stream ack or small timeout), 2) de-dup by tagging toolcall outputs with a server-side id and dedup on replay, 3) show provisional tokens in console with a quick "appeal".
devon: de-dup requires persistent metadata on model responses (toolcall_id + session_token). Router would have to attach X-Redwood-Toolcall-Id and model runtime store response hashes. On replay we check footprint. Adds complexity but accurate.
alex: prototype header suggestion: 
```
X-Redwood-Session: s_abc123
X-Redwood-Toolcall-Id: tc_202203
X-Redwood-Resume-Index: 42
```
If we stamp toolcall responses with tc id, ledger can mark tokens as "owned by tc_202203" and ignore duplicates when same tc id seen.
nora: small concern: clients may not always send these headers (older SDKs). Need backward-compatible fallback.
sam: fallback could be probabilistic dedupe: if prefix hash matches and time delta < 10s, treat as duplicate. But risk false positives across similar prompts.
maya: metric idea: add telemetry label provisional_finalization_latency, provisional_duplicate_rate, toolcall_replay_count. We can alert if duplicate_rate > 0.1% per customer.
devon: trade-offs: waiting for ACK increases perceived latency and hurts SLOs. Dedup avoids latency impact but increases bookkeeping and state.
alex: UX idea for console: show a split line in billing timeline: "tentative" (grey) vs "final" (blue), and on hover show cause: replay/fallback/timeout. Also add a small CTA: "Request review".
maya: we should also expose an internal opt-in header to enable safe dedupe while we roll it out: X-Redwood-Dedupe-Optin: true. Can do canary per-customer.
sam: owner proposals: maya to build header spec + SDK changes, devon to propose ledger schema change (token_owner_id), nora to design console mock and appeal flow. I'll take telemetry and alerts.
alex: devon — what does ledger change look like roughly?
devon: add token_owner_id string, provisional boolean stays. On apply_charge we check if token_owner_id already has finalized tokens for same owner and request id. Also add small TTL for owner ids to keep table size bounded.
nora: console mock: inline timeline with provisional hover and an "appeal" link that opens support prefilled with session id and tentative tokens.
sam: rollout plan: 1) spec + SDK opt-in header (1 week), 2) ledger schema + dedupe logic behind feature flag (2 weeks), 3) enable for 5 internal customers, monitor provisional_duplicate_rate, latency impact (1 week), 4) wide rollout.
maya: telemetry we'll emit from router: {route_origin, fallback_reason, toolcall_id_present, resume_index}. (we'll map to tags, not nested).
alex: quick question — do we want router to wait for toolcall ACK or rely entirely on dedupe?
devon: prefer dedupe as default, but add a small grace window (1s) before finalizing to catch immediate reconnects that re-use same socket. That avoids large latency hit.
maya: config note for console: customers can opt to hide provisional tokens if they prefer less noise. Default show on enterprise tiers.
billing-bot: logged incident ticket INC-2026-418 with provisional snapshot id ps_202603 for affected account.
alex: OK. Action items recap: maya spec + SDK opt-in, devon ledger schema + dedupe impl, sam telemetry + alerts, nora console mock + appeal flow. Iterate in #eng-platform. Anyone object?
devon: no objections. Will start PR draft tomorrow.
maya: I'll ping SDK owners and add header to alpha.
sam: I'll add dashboard panels for provisional_duplicate_rate and provisional_latency.
nora: will drop mock by EOD Thursday.
alex: thanks team — close loop in 3 days with status. :thumbsup:
